purpose: Input manifest of the final weapon residual convergence. Audit evidence only: no runtime module reads it and it does not feed the 5D-H closure census. Automation level (AUTO / CONTEXTUAL / GM_ADJUDICATED) is an additional dimension; BLOCKED is reserved for a missing mechanical consumer. Tripwires prove what does NOT exist today and fail the census the day it does.

subpasses.I-D-A: umbrella: stealth / concealment / sensing / visibility rows settled by the census itself (proven duplicate, non-executable, source-silent, missing consumer)
subpasses.I-D-A1: carried-item / weapon skill bonuses through the existing EquipmentSkillHookResolver -> skill-roll path
subpasses.I-D-A2: contextual smoke / gas / radiation clouds: GM-established concealment or exposure through existing combat authorities; duration on the existing timing authority
subpasses.I-D-A3: GM-adjudicated rule presentation: line-of-sight origin, silent / invisible firing, audibility, sensor scans, compass
subpasses.I-D-B: weapon durability, construction, mounting, upgrades and size-derived wielding
subpasses.I-D-C: special activation, resources and remote operation
subpasses.I-D-D: poison coating and unresolved damage semantics
subpasses.I-D-E: weapon / feat / talent relationships and remaining certification
subpasses.I-D-F: reload / ammo-resource special cases (approved subpass for the 12 reload / power-source / capacity keys)
